capabilities: convert a resume note to a one-page A4 PDF
refuse export when content cannot fit on one page
export from status bar, context menu, or command palette
configure the output folder and auto-open behavior
extras: Desktop-only (macOS, Windows, Linux); not available on mobile. PDF is saved beside the note by default, with a configurable folder option.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a resume note into a nicely typeset, fixed one-page PDF without extra software or code.
summary: Exports a Markdown resume note to a polished one-page A4 PDF via status bar button, context menu, or command.
